brief:
Israeli military officials have recommended that the country's political leadership avoid launching a direct attack on Yemen's Houthi group and refrain from military operations that would place Israel at the forefront of armed confrontation, Shehab Wire reported. The military instead called for intensifying political and diplomatic efforts to address the group's activities.

The recommendation reflects apparent Israeli military concerns about escalating tensions with the Houthis, who have launched attacks on shipping and other targets in recent months amid the Gaza conflict.

title: Israeli military urges political level to avoid direct confrontation with Houthis
